heard: Our sun and entire galaxy are being pulled across space. Astronomers thought a local pull called the Great Attractor was responsible, but that mysterious cosmic anchor is getting dragged along with us. The real Titan sits 650 million light years away in Centaurus. The Shapley Supercluster packs over 8,000 whole galaxies together. Its total mass exceeds 10 million billion suns combined. It is the most massive structure within a billion light years. Because right now, this monster is reeling our world across the dark.
